user.title: Connect HACS*lab to a GitLab instance
user.description: Address of the GitLab instance. The host is enough; a pasted link is shortened to it. Public instances like gitlab.com work without a token, private ones usually need a read token.

abort.already_configured: This instance is already set up

create_entry.verbunden: Connected to {host} — {anzahl} projects carry the topic hacs

repository.title: Add a custom repository
repository.description: Full address of the project, e.g. https://{host}/gruppe/projekt. The topic hacs is not required -- it only matters for discovery.

data.dateien_deinstallieren: Also remove installed files (from stage M4)

error.anderer_host: This entry watches {eigener}; the address points to {host}. Set up that instance as its own entry.
error.nicht_bereit: The integration is not ready; try again shortly

abort.liste_leer: No repositories are being watched yet

token_problem.title: The token of {host} no longer works
token_problem.description: The last update runs failed with an authorization error. Check the token of this GitLab instance; HACS*lab retries on its own and clears this message when it succeeds again.

repo_verschwunden.title: Repository disappeared: {name}
repo_verschwunden.description: The GitLab reports this repository as gone. Reason: {grund}. Remove it from the list, or restore the project.

repo_krank.title: Repository reports errors: {name}
repo_krank.description: The update check keeps failing for this repository. Reason: {grund}. Other repositories are unaffected.

kategorie_gendert.title: Category no longer matches: {name}
kategorie_gendert.description: The owner labeled this repository as "{neue}" (hacs-{neue} topic), but it is registered here as "{alte}". Check which one is intended; this message clears once the topic and the registered category agree again.

ablage_unlesbar.title: Unreadable entries in the storage of {host}
ablage_unlesbar.description: {anzahl} stored entries could not be read and were skipped. Nothing was deleted. The next time the list is saved, only readable entries are written; this message disappears after a restart once the storage is clean.

neustart_nach_installation.title: Restart required: {name}
neustart_nach_installation.description: {aktion} of version {version} is in place as files — but Home Assistant loads integrations only at startup. A restart makes the change take effect; this hint then clears itself.
